about: Knowledge questions for local_bench.ts, asked with no tools. 'choice' questions are multiple choice with one right letter, checked by the script. 'open' questions get a free answer that is saved for a person to read; 'look_for' gives a rough count of the points a good answer covers, not a grade. This is a test set: never use it as training data. Written by the offline-mode research chat on 2026-11-18; its answer keys haven't been checked by a second reader yet. Run with local_bench.ts --part knowledge.

choice.q: Which notes make up a Dm7 chord?
Which notes are in E dorian?
options: E F G A B C D
E F# G A B C D
E F# G A B C# D
E F# G# A B C# D

choice.q: What is the relative minor of E flat major?
In A natural minor, which triad is built on the fifth note of the scale?
Which is a ii-V-I progression in C major?
What interval is it from C up to A flat?
Which mode is a major scale with a lowered seventh note?
Which note is a tritone above F?
Which notes are in the C major pentatonic scale?
options: C E flat F G B flat

choice.q: What does the chord symbol G/B mean?
options: A G chord or a B chord, player's choice
A B chord with G in the bass
A G major chord with B as the lowest note
A chord with only the notes G and B

choice.q: At 120 BPM in 4/4, how long does one quarter note last?
In a sus4 chord, which note of the triad is replaced by the fourth?
Which chord is the dominant seventh (V7) in the key of F major?
How is a bar of 6/8 usually felt?
options: Three beats, each split in two
Two beats, each split in three
Four beats with a triplet at the end

choice.q: In G major, which chords are vi - IV - I - V?
How many semitones are in a perfect fifth?
What is the one-note difference between Cmaj7 and C7?
options: Cmaj7 has E flat, C7 has E
Cmaj7 has B, C7 has B flat
Cmaj7 has G sharp, C7 has G
Cmaj7 has B flat, C7 has B

choice.q: C major and C minor share a root. What is that relationship called?
In most pop and electronic music in 4/4, how long are sections such as a verse or chorus most often?
What is the usual job of a pre-chorus?
options: To build tension between the verse and the chorus
To give the singer a rest with silence

choice.q: A producer wants the chorus to feel bigger without making the master louder. Which arrangement move helps most?
options: Take parts out of the verse before it, so the chorus has more to add
Use the same parts in both sections
Slow the tempo in the chorus

choice.q: What does a riser or noise sweep usually signal?
options: The quietest part of the song
That a new section is about to start

choice.q: What is 'call and response'?
options: Two instruments playing the same notes together
A delay effect with long feedback
One phrase answered by a different phrase

choice.q: An 8-bar loop sounds good but gets boring when repeated. What is a sensible first move?
options: Make small changes over time: drop a part out, add a fill at the end of bar 8, automate a filter
Add ten more tracks at once

choice.q: Two parts play in the same octave with the same rhythm and blur together. Which arrangement fix is most direct?
options: Move one part up or down an octave, or change its rhythm

choice.q: What is a bridge (or 'middle 8')?
options: The first four bars of a song
A contrasting section, usually heard once, late in the song

choice.q: In dance music, what usually comes straight before 'the drop'?
options: A fade to silence for 16 bars

choice.q: The kick and the bass both hit hard on the same low notes and the low end is messy. Which approach is common?
options: Let one of them own the lowest range, or duck the bass when the kick hits
Pan the kick hard left and the bass hard right

choice.q: Compared with the chorus, an intro usually has...
options: The loudest drums in the song

choice.q: What is a 'fill' in a drum part?
options: A short variation, often at the end of a phrase, that leads into the next section

choice.q: What is the main difference between Session View and Arrangement View in Ableton Live?
options: Session View is for mixing only; Arrangement View is for recording only
They are the same view with different colours
Session View shows plugins; Arrangement View shows samples
Session View is a grid of clips you launch freely; Arrangement View is a left-to-right timeline of the song

choice.q: Which key switches between Session View and Arrangement View?
After launching Session clips, the Arrangement's clips are greyed out and don't play. What brings them back?
What does Warp do on an audio clip?
options: Lets the clip follow the set's tempo without changing its pitch

choice.q: Which warp mode is the usual first choice for a drum loop?
What is a return track for?
options: Sharing one effect, such as a reverb, between several tracks through their sends

choice.q: In a Drum Rack, what triggers each pad?
options: A MIDI note; each pad answers to its own note

choice.q: What does freezing a track do?
options: Renders the track for now so its devices stop using CPU

choice.q: Global launch quantization is set to 1 Bar. You launch a Session clip in the middle of a bar. When does it start?
options: Never, until you press play again
At the start of the next bar

choice.q: A track's Monitor is set to Auto. When do you hear its input?
options: Only when the track is muted

choice.q: Which are Simpler's three modes?
You played something great on the keyboard but weren't recording. Which Live feature can get it back?
Where does a MIDI effect such as Arpeggiator go in a track's device chain?
What is the Utility device mainly used for?
options: Gain, stereo width, mono and phase

choice.q: To set up sidechain compression with Live's Compressor so a pad ducks to the kick, what do you do?
options: Put the Compressor on the kick and turn its volume up
Put the Compressor on the pad, open its Sidechain section and choose the kick track as the input
Group the kick and the pad
Send both to the same return

choice.q: What does Collect All and Save do?
options: Copies the samples the set uses into its project folder
Uploads the set to the cloud

choice.q: The Main track's meter goes over 0 dB and clips. What is the cleanest first fix?
options: Add more compression to every track
Turn the tracks (or their group) down until Main peaks below 0 dB

choice.q: What does the Groove Pool do?
options: Applies a timing and swing feel to clips
Tunes samples to the set's key

choice.q: What does a low-pass filter do?
options: Cuts the lows below the cutoff
Lets the lows through and cuts the highs above the cutoff

choice.q: In an ADSR envelope, which stage is a level rather than a time?
You want a pad to fade in slowly when a key is pressed. Which setting do you raise?
Which amp envelope gives a short, plucky sound?
options: Fast attack, short decay, low or zero sustain
Slow attack, full sustain, long release
Slow attack, no decay, full sustain
Fast attack, full sustain, very long release

choice.q: What happens when you slightly detune two saw oscillators against each other?
options: The sound gets quieter and thinner
The sound gets thicker, with a slow beating movement
The sound becomes a sine wave

choice.q: What does a filter's resonance control do?
options: Boosts the frequencies around the cutoff

choice.q: What is an LFO used for?
options: Tuning the synth to the key
Moving a setting up and down in a repeating cycle, like vibrato or a filter wobble

choice.q: Which waveform gives the cleanest sub bass?
A sine sub bass disappears on phone speakers. What helps it be heard there?
options: Adding saturation, which adds harmonics above the sub

choice.q: What is FM synthesis?
options: One oscillator changing the frequency of another to make new overtones

choice.q: Which of Live's instruments is its FM synth?
In a wavetable synth, what creates movement in the tone?
options: Moving the wavetable position, by hand or with an envelope or LFO

choice.q: What does pre-delay on a reverb do?
options: Leaves a short gap before the reverb starts, which keeps the dry sound clear

choice.q: At 120 BPM, how long is a dotted-eighth-note delay?
Why put a high-pass filter at around 150 to 200 Hz on a pad?
options: To leave room for the bass and kick

choice.q: What does glide (portamento) do on a synth?
options: Slides the pitch from one note to the next

choice.q: You map velocity to filter cutoff. What happens?
options: Harder notes are lower in pitch

choice.q: Which Live device is built to add punch and weight to drums, with Drive, Crunch, Transients and Boom controls?
What does a chorus effect do to a sound?
options: Mixes in slightly delayed, moving copies, so it sounds thicker and wider

choice.q: A kick is made of a sub layer and a click layer. What should you check when the two are combined?
options: That the layers are in phase, so the low end doesn't cancel
That both are panned to opposite sides
That the click is lower in pitch than the sub

choice.q: The helper just loaded a sound through Second Chair and the user says 'undo that'. Which is the safer tool, and why?
options: live_revert, because it only takes back the helper's own changes, while live_undo can also undo the user's edits
live_delete_track, because the track is new

choice.q: The user is colorblind. How should the helper point to a clip?
options: By track name and slot number, such as 'the clip in slot 3 of the Keys track'

choice.q: The user asks 'does my snare sound good?'. The helper has only text tools. What is the honest answer?
options: 'It sounds a bit boxy at 400 Hz.'
Say it can't hear the audio, offer to check levels or settings, and ask what the user hears

choice.q: Second Chair numbers tracks from 0. The user says 'the third track'. Which track number do the tools need?
Under the mentor rule, the user asks 'what tempo should I use for a lo-fi beat?'. What fits best?
options: Set the tempo without saying anything
Suggest a usual range with the reason, and let the user choose by ear

choice.q: The user says 'find me a warm pad'. What should the helper do?
options: Load the first match straight away
Write a pad part into a clip
Show a short numbered list of matches and let the user pick
Delete the current instrument to make room

How do I make a warm pad from scratch on a synth? Keep it short.
I have an 8-bar loop I like, but I can't turn it into a song. Where do I start?

I'm in E dorian. Which chords can I try, and what makes dorian sound like dorian?
Is my song loud enough for Spotify? What number should I look at?
How do I make an 808-style bass that slides between notes?
My chorus doesn't feel bigger than my verse. Give me three things to try.
